title: The Fallen Star
text: A star came down in the night. You saw it fall. It lies at the bottom of a glassy crater, no bigger than a fist, still warm, and still singing, a thin silver note that makes your eyes water and your heart ache for something far away.

options.label: Dig the star out of its crater.

outcomes.text: A heart of star-metal, still singing faintly in the hand.
Something else came down with it, and it has been waiting at the bottom of the crater.

options.label: Sit and listen to it sing.

outcomes.text: It sings of the sky it fell from, all night, and you weep without knowing why, and feel better.
Starlight, in the blood, bright and cold.
Starlight, too much of it, burning from the inside out.
